Vario Shipping Group is looking for motivated candidates from Slovakia who would like to join our vessels and develop towards becoming a qualified Boatman in European inland shipping. You do not need to be a qualified Boatman when you apply. We are looking for people with the right motivation, attitude and willingness to learn. Who are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: • Is motivated to work in European inland shipping • Is comfortable working and living on board for several weeks at a time • Is practical, responsible and safety-conscious • Enjoys working as part of an international team • Is willing to learn and develop professionally • Has sufficient English to communicate safely and effectively on board Experience in inland shipping, maritime work or a technical environment is an advantage, but not essential for every candidate. Experience on tanker vessels is also an advantage. Vario Shipping Group | EURES Recruitment – Slovakia Already qualified? If you already hold a recognised Boatman qualification for European inland shipping, we would be happy to hear from you. Your previous experience and qualifications will be taken into account when discussing your position and employment conditions. Training towards the Boatman qualification You do not need to hold the Boatman qualification when you apply. If you have the right motivation and are interested in building a career in inland shipping, Vario will look at the possibilities for you to develop towards the Boatman qualification. We will first explore whether the required training and examination can be completed in Slovakia. If a suitable route is not available in Slovakia, you must be willing to follow the necessary Boatman training and examination in English in the Netherlands. Vario Shipping Group will support you in finding an appropriate training route and in your further professional development.
